Sarah (Sales): Heads-up — Monarch Health wants to run a quick POC with their in-house model 'monarch-13b'. They want quality + latency numbers and an isolation plan for EU data. Can we scope?
Tomas (Solutions): Do we know format and tokenizer license? If tokenizer is closed-source we may need a different ingestion path. Also does model require rmsnorm or custom attention?
Sarah (Sales): Customer says HF tarball, custom tokenizer (proprietary), no custom CUDA kernels. They want to test 2 concurrency levels and a 500-token prompt SLO.
Miguel (Infra): Sounds doable. We should validate: 1) model architecture (llama-like) 2) kv cache layout 3) dtype/activations. If tokenizer is proprietary we can't ship it directly in hosted catalog — but for private/VPC POC it's fine under NDA.
Jenna (EngOps): For EU residency we can spin a private deployment in eu-west-1. Timeline: sandbox infra in ~72 hours after artifact + NDA. Pricing note: short POC using single node w/ 1 GPU: estimate €900/day excluding storage. If they want burst we need reserved capacity.
Priya (Security): Security blockers: customer-managed KMS, audit logs retained for 90 days, RBAC scoped to their tokens. Also need confirmation on PII handling — they asked that logs not persist beyond 24h during POC. We can support that config.
Luke (Legal): If tokenizer is proprietary we need a license confirmation and a footprint statement for our indemnity team. Also add NDA addendum clause for model IP transfer and ephemeral logs.
Tomas (Solutions): I'll prepare a compatibility checklist. Can someone give me a sample prompt and a small tokenizer test file to sanity-check tokenization mapping? I can run a local convert.
Miguel (Infra): Upload pattern: pre-signed URL to internal artifacts bucket. I can kick off an automated convert+smoke: `./tools/convert_model --input <url> --target rw-inference --test-prompts sample_prompts.json`
Sarah (Sales): I'll ask Monarch to provide pre-signed URL + sample prompts. Also asking about quantization tolerance — would they accept q4_0? It'd cut cost.
Tomas (Solutions): If they accept q4 formats we can test that path; note output parity will need to be validated by Monarch. We'll add a short eval script they can run.
Priya (Security): One more: they require SOC2 attestation and a short table of controls we meet for POC. I'll attach a controls snapshot once I get the exact fields.
Jenna (EngOps): I'll draft a POC SKUs estimate: sandbox (single node) vs dedicated (3-node) + optional KMS setup fee. ETA for pricing note EOD tomorrow.
Luke (Legal): I'll draft a short addendum skeleton for tokenizer licensing + log handling.
DeployBot: Runbook created: https://internal/wiki/monarch-poc-init (created by @tomas.solutions).
Sarah (Sales): Cool — plan: 1) NDA addendum + license confirmation (Luke) 2) artifact URL + sample prompts (customer) 3) compat smoke (Tomas/Miguel) 4) security attestation (Priya) 5) pricing stub (Jenna). Aim to have results next week. I'll ping folks when artifact arrives. Thanks. :seedling:
